proposals.evidence: Full būṭa subsection 2 būṭṭa explicitly lists Lahnda/Punjabi būṭā and West Pahari buṭṭ/būṭā tree, plus Kotgarhi bvṭṭi plant/tree. This supports selected northern u-vowel tree responses and their ordinary inflection. Source dental/retroflex notation, nasalization and vowels remain intact; local transmission is qualified. Distinct o-vowel and aspirated-head branches are not automatically conflated. Exact response: buta.
